items.event: Davis Cup Final: Italy vs Spain (Bologna)
items.line: A rematch of last year's final. Two-time defending champions Italy, without the injured Sinner, edged Czechia 2-1. Alcaraz is fresh off his ATP Finals title and swept Spain past Britain 2-0. It is David Ferrer's last tie as captain.

sources.name: AP via Yahoo Sports
sources.title: Alcaraz and Spain through to Davis Cup final after 2-0 win against Britain

items.event: Arsenal vs Man City – Premier League
items.line: Leaders and defending champions Arsenal are six points clear of third-placed City and can go nine clear. City have no win in their last four league games. Saka and Zubimendi are out and Raya is a doubt for Arsenal; Semenyo is out for City.
